codex.viltrumitecore.gui.title: Viltrum Chronicles
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.subtitle: an encyclopedia of heroes, monsters and events
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.interaction.loc: Not discovered yet. Find out yourself how it happens.
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.interaction.non: The catalog has no interactions for this entry yet.
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.catalog.missing: The contextual interaction catalog is not part of this build yet. Its entries will appear here automatically once it is included.
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.catalog.invalid: The interaction catalog is damaged and could not be read.
codex.viltrumitecore.gui.select: Pick an entry on the left.
codex.viltrumitecore.homelander.name: Homelander
codex.viltrumitecore.homelander.role: the strongest of the Seven, heir to Viltrum's power
codex.viltrumitecore.homelander.lore: A smile for the cameras, ice in the eyes. This power was once called Viltrumite; now it wears a star-spangled cape and tolerates no objections.
codex.viltrumitecore.homelander.gameplay: Inherits the whole Viltrumite kit: sonic punch, dash through blocks, thunderclap, grab and barrage. On top of it: heat vision, Focus through walls and a stunning roar. Free flight with a supersonic mode and his own regeneration.
codex.viltrumitecore.homelander.relation: The Viltrumites Thula, Lucan, Vidor and Conquest carry the same power for real and do not see him as one of their own.
codex.viltrumitecore.regulus.name: Regulus Corneas
codex.viltrumitecore.regulus.lore: He insists he wants nothing — except for the world to leave him alone. His own time is stopped, so nothing can change him: no blade, no fire, no other will.
codex.viltrumitecore.regulus.gameplay: Lion's Heart stops his own time: damage, pushes and effects never reach him, and part of a blow recoils on the attacker. Stopped sand and air become weapons, his trample splits the ground, and Little King hides his heart inside living beings (middle mouse button).
codex.viltrumitecore.regulus.relations: Reinhard is the only one whose sword ever made Regulus afraid. Both came from the same world.
codex.viltrumitecore.ironman.name: Iron Man
codex.viltrumitecore.ironman.role: Tony Stark: genius, the Mark 50 nanosuit and a whole arsenal
codex.viltrumitecore.ironman.lore: An arc reactor in the chest, sarcasm on the tongue and JARVIS in the helmet. The suit flows out of the nano reactor in a second, and if that is not enough, Veronica drops from the sky.
codex.viltrumitecore.ironman.gameplay: The suit runs on energy: at zero it glides instead of flying. Unibeam, marked micro-missiles, nano blade and hammer, scanning with JARVIS and flares. Veronica delivers the Hulkbuster, the Iron Legion calls up to three stored marks.
codex.viltrumitecore.ironman.relations: Captain America knows another Tony — the Mark 42 armour in his Avengers team. The Iron Legion is his own marks on autopilot.
codex.viltrumitecore.reinhard.name: Reinhard van Astrea
codex.viltrumitecore.reinhard.role: the Sword Saint, beloved of blessings
codex.viltrumitecore.reinhard.lore: The world loves him too much: blessings find him in battle on their own. The Dragon Sword Reid leaves its sheath only for a worthy foe — and then the world itself falls silent.
codex.viltrumitecore.reinhard.gameplay: Three modes — Restrained, Knight and Holy Sword — switch with the middle mouse button, each with its own moves. Blessings are always on: phoenix, adaptation, parry, arrow ward. Drawn Reid unlocks the Saw Sphere, the World Cut and the Erasure.
codex.viltrumitecore.reinhard.relations: Regulus Corneas is a foe from his home world. Thanos is beyond his divine strikes: the stones' power is of another order.
codex.viltrumitecore.thor.name: Thor
codex.viltrumitecore.thor.role: the god of thunder from the age of Ragnarök
codex.viltrumitecore.thor.lore: A weary god who has lived through too much to joke about war. Mjölnir always returns to his hand, and thunder follows him.
codex.viltrumitecore.thor.gameplay: Throw and recall Mjölnir, dash to the flying hammer, a crushing blow and an electric mode with lightning and storms. The teleport point is picked from a top-down camera. The ultimate calls lightning down onto the battlefield. There can be only one god of thunder in the world.
codex.viltrumitecore.thor.relations: Captain America's team has another Thor — younger, from 2012. They share little beyond the hammer.
codex.viltrumitecore.dio.name: DIO
codex.viltrumitecore.dio.role: vampire and master of the Stand The World
codex.viltrumitecore.dio.lore: He cast away humanity for eternity and now looks down on the world — literally, from atop a road roller. His Stand, The World, does one thing that matters most: stop time.
codex.viltrumitecore.dio.gameplay: The World comes out on command: an LMB combo, a guard, the MUDA barrage. Knives hang in stopped time and fly on when it moves again. ZA WARUDO costs blood, which the vampire drain provides. The ultimate is the road roller.
codex.viltrumitecore.dio.relations: While time stands still, even Thanos's clock waits. Regulus stops only his own time — DIO stops everyone else's.
codex.viltrumitecore.sinclair.name: The Magnificent Sinclair
codex.viltrumitecore.sinclair.role: ghost magician: two performers in one body
codex.viltrumitecore.sinclair.lore: Henry and Savannah once played the finest stages; now they share one wooden body. Every fight is an act for them: setup, misdirection, reveal and a bow.
codex.viltrumitecore.sinclair.gameplay: Wins by deception, not raw power: the vexing bolt, the spectral assistant (press again to swap places), the rabbit hex and a decoy. The ultimate, Audience Participation, copies a rival's act. He cannot fly and is fragile — keep your distance.
codex.viltrumitecore.sinclair.relations: The spectral assistant is his eternal stage partner.
codex.viltrumitecore.jinwoo.name: Sung Jinwoo
codex.viltrumitecore.jinwoo.lore: The weakest hunter became the one the fallen kneel to. Every defeated enemy may rise again — inside his shadow.
codex.viltrumitecore.jinwoo.gameplay: Shadow Step, Mutilation and Ruler's Authority — telekinesis on up to six creatures. From the souls of the slain he extracts shadows ("Arise") and commands an army of up to twelve: attack, guard, sentinels. The ultimate raises the legion in waves.
codex.viltrumitecore.jinwoo.relations: The shadow army — Igris, Beru, Tank and everyone he raised himself.
codex.viltrumitecore.captain.name: Captain America
codex.viltrumitecore.captain.lore: A man out of his time who stands up first and never gives up. His shield does not break, and his team comes the moment he calls.
codex.viltrumitecore.captain.gameplay: Blocking with the shield builds kinetic charge. A ricochet across several enemies, a shield rush, a vibranium slam into the ground and a tactical roll. The ultimate, Avengers, Assemble!, brings the Quinjet and the whole team into the fight.
codex.viltrumitecore.captain.relations: His Avengers: Iron Man, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye. He remembers New York in 2012 by the Chitauri invasion.
codex.viltrumitecore.human.name: Human
codex.viltrumitecore.human.lore: Every hero of this world was once just a human. Od Lagna hears every wish — and can give the old life back to those who grow tired of power.
codex.viltrumitecore.human.gameplay: A new player starts as a human. The only way to become a hero is Od Lagna's Wish; the last wish on the list returns you to a human life.
codex.viltrumitecore.human.relations: The citizens of Atheria live ordinary lives until another battle thunders over their city.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.name: Conquest
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.look: A huge grey-haired warrior in Imperial armour, taller than any human. His scars are his service record.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.lore: The Empire sends Conquest where others have failed. He does not negotiate; he tests whether a world deserves to exist.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.abilities: The full Viltrumite kit: flight, crushing blows, dashes and grabs. Hits harder and takes punishment better than a rank-and-file Viltrumite.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.behavior: Hostile to everyone around and takes no allies. Appears only in the Conquest's Arrival event.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest.relations: Thula, Lucan and Vidor are his kin. Homelander carries the same power, but Conquest would never call him a Viltrumite.
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad.ro: Thula, Lucan and Vidor — elite Imperial warriors
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad.lo: Three warriors in dark Imperial armour. Thula is swift and light, Lucan is the biggest, Vidor the seasoned fighter in between.
Viltrumites honour strength above all. The squad arrives as three, and it is beaten only when the last one falls.
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad.ab: Flight, Viltrumite punches and dashes. Each has their own size, strength and fighting style.
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad.be: They attack everyone without distinction. The event announces how many Viltrumites are still alive.
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad.re: They serve the same Empire as Conquest.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_soldier.lo: Grey armour grown into the body, glowing inserts and an energy spear-rifle.
The Chitauri know neither fear nor mercy: they are a tool in the hands of whoever opened the portal.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_soldier.ab: They fire energy bolts and fight in squads.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_soldier.be: They look for cover, stay in groups and board chariots to attack from the air.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_soldier.re: They come only with the Chitauri invasion, together with chariots and Leviathans.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_chariot.lo: A narrow hovering platform with an engine, glowing thrusters and seats for gunners.
Chariots tear between the towers at rooftop height; their roar is heard long before they appear.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_chariot.ab: Fast, agile flight with soldiers on board.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_chariot.be: Weaves over the battlefield on its own course while the gunners on board open fire.
A gigantic metal-clad worm of many segments with glowing plates.
When a Leviathan shows in the sky, the city understands: this is no longer a raid, it is war.
Rams buildings with its body and ploughs through towers.
Routes itself through the tallest buildings, wrecking everything in its path.
The heavy hitter of the Chitauri invasion.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.name: Thanos
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.role: the Mad Titan with the Infinity Gauntlet, boss
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.look: A huge purple titan in golden armour. On his left hand, the gauntlet with all six stones.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.lore: He came alone: he no longer needs an army. The heroes have six minutes before he snaps his fingers.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.abilities: Every stone grants its own moves: the power punch, space portals, reality mirages, the time dome, the mind gaze, soul tethers — and their combinations. Every move gives a fair warning by stone colour, pose and sound.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.behavior: Grows stronger each phase and strikes faster in the final minute. Damage to him is capped, and divine strikes do not touch him.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos.relations: Od Lagna is the only power that can bring the world back after the snap.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_iron_man.ro: Captain's ally in the Mark 42 armour
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_iron_man.lo: Red-and-gold Mark 42 armour; behind the raised faceplate, Tony's face.
Another Tony, from 2012: even more confident and still unaware of how it all ends.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_iron_man.ab: Repulsors and flight. With Thor he performs a joint move: lightning into the repulsor and an amplified beam.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_iron_man.be: Arrives at the call Avengers, Assemble!, fights beside Steve and leaves when the battle is over.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_iron_man.re: A member of Captain America's team.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.name: Thor (Avengers)
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.role: Captain's ally, the 2012 god of thunder
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.look: Cape, armour and Mjölnir in the style of the first Avengers.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.lore: The young prince of Asgard, who has not yet lost his hammer or his home.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.abilit: Lightning and hammer strikes. Joint moves: Mjölnir on Steve's shield — a stunning shockwave; a discharge into Iron Man's repulsor.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.behavi: Comes at the Captain's call and stays close to the team in battle.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_thor.relati: Not to be confused with the Ragnarök-era Thor, the one you can play.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.name: Hulk
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.role: Captain's ally, a living battering ram
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.look: A green giant taller than anyone on the team; veins and muscle under the skin.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.lore: Bruce Banner's secret is simple: he is always angry.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.abilit: Thunderous blows, leaps and a roar. Takes more punishment than anyone on the team.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.behavi: Crashes into the thick of the enemy. Does not fit under a low ceiling and waits outside.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hulk.relati: A member of Captain America's team.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_black_widow: A black tactical suit, red hair and stingers on her wrists.
Natasha Romanoff is used to being where nobody expects her.
Fast strikes and shocks. With Hawkeye: a vault off his shoulders and an arrow volley.
Drops from the Quinjet and stays near Steve.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hawkeye.loo: A dark suit, a bow and a quiver of trick arrows.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hawkeye.lor: Clint Barton never misses — and never says how many arrows he has left.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hawkeye.abi: Arrows: normal, explosive and shock. Together with Widow he looses a four-wave volley.
codex.viltrumitecore.avenger_hawkeye.beh: Keeps his distance and covers the team from afar.
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.name: Iron Legion
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.look: Iron Man's stored marks without a pilot, their eyes glowing.
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.lore: Tony never learned to trust others, so he built those he can trust.
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.abiliti: Up to three suits break in from the sky and guard their owner.
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.behavio: Each mark keeps its durability on record: a broken suit crashes and goes on cooldown.
codex.viltrumitecore.iron_legion.relatio: Called by the Iron Man hero.
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.name: Shadow Army
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.role: the fallen who serve the Shadow Monarch
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.look: Black silhouettes with violet eyes. Among them: the knight Igris, the ant Beru and the huge Tank.
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.lore: Death is not the end for those the Monarch accepts. Weak souls obey at once; strong ones sometimes resist.
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.abiliti: Attack on command, form a guarding ring, hide in others' shadows as sentinels.
codex.viltrumitecore.shadow_army.behavio: Follow Sung Jinwoo's orders and return to his shadow when called.
A translucent figure in a stage costume.
No trick works without an assistant — especially when the magician is a ghost.
Distracts enemies. Pressing again swaps her place with Sinclair.
Mobs treat her as a target; damage to her does not pass to Sinclair, but she is easy to bring down.
Appears only beside the Magnificent Sinclair.
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.name: Citizens of Atheria
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.role: the peaceful population of the living city
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.lore: They do not care about gods and titans — until those start fighting over their heads.
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.abilities: No superpowers. But they notice danger and run from destruction.
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.behavior: Live only in a world with the Atheria city profile and appear after /city enable. Heroes' automatic targeting skips them.
codex.viltrumitecore.citizen.relations: The city remembers the damage: /city reset restores it.
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.name: Od Lagna
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.role: an ancient power that hears every wish
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.look: White and golden radiance, a halo and shimmering motes.
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.lore: Her light remembers the world as it was, and so it can bring it back — even after Thanos's snap.
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.abilities: Grants wishes: the power of a hero or the return to a human life.
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.behavior: Hears whoever holds Od Lagna's Wish. Appears in the void after Thanos's snap and restores the world.
codex.viltrumitecore.od_lagna.relations: Through her, any human becomes a hero.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest_arrival.ro: a Viltrumite boss descends from the sky
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest_arrival.lo: First comes the warning. Then the sky splits, and the Empire sends its finest soldier.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest_arrival.st:
1. Announcement and countdown.
2. Conquest appears above the players.
3. The fight until he falls.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest_arrival.fe: Started manually only: /viltrumite event start conquest. A server restart ends the event.
codex.viltrumitecore.conquest_arrival.re: Does not run alongside the Chitauri invasion or a meteor rain unless forced.
codex.viltrumitecore.viltrumite_squad_ev: Thula, Lucan and Vidor arrive as three. The Empire considers that enough.

1. Warning and countdown.
2. Three Viltrumites land.
3. Announcements of how many remain.
4. The end when the last one falls.
Start: /viltrumite event start trio. Each of the three hits and endures differently.
The same event compatibility rules as Conquest's Arrival.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.name: Meteor Fall
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.role: a stone from the sky and Infinity Gun parts
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.lore: Sometimes the sky brings gifts on its own — hot, heavy and dangerous.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.stages:
1. The meteor enters the atmosphere.
2. Impact, explosion and a magma crater.
3. Debris that may hold Infinity Gun parts.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.feature: Happens in the Overworld by a configurable chance. The assembled Infinity Gun is charged with nether stars.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_fall.relatio: The meteor rain uses the same meteors, but without loot.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.name: Meteor Rain
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.lore: The sky burns, the ground shakes, and the only advice is: keep moving.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.stages:
1. Starts around the chosen players.
2. Meteors fall one by one and in bursts of 2–3.
3. After a stop, meteors already in the air still land.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.partici: The players the rain falls around.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.feature: Commands /meteor start, /meteor stop, /meteor status. Never loads chunks and pauses while time is stopped. Rain meteors drop no loot.
codex.viltrumitecore.meteor_rain.relatio: Does not combine with the Chitauri invasion or Viltrumite events unless forced.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_invasion.r: a portal over the city and an army from another world
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_invasion.l: The sky above the city tears into a vortex, and out of it comes an army that does not care whom it destroys.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_invasion.s:
1. The portal opens.
2. Ground assault.
3. Air assault on chariots.
4. Leviathans.
5. Final battle.
6. The portal collapses.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_invasion.f: About seven minutes. Destruction follows the mobGriefing rule and never loads chunks. Command /chitauri start|stop|status.
codex.viltrumitecore.chitauri_invasion.r: Captain America has seen this before — in New York, 2012.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.name: Thanos and the Six Stones
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.lore: Thanos comes alone, with the full gauntlet. If the heroes do not stop him in time, he snaps his fingers — and the universe crumbles into light.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.stages:
1. Arrival: one stone per move.
2. Escalation: the first stone combos.
3. Onslaught: three-stone combos.
4. Final minute: everything faster and brighter.
5. The heroes win — or the snap, the void and Od Lagna restoring the world.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.partici: Thanos, every hero nearby, Od Lagna.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.feature: His health scales with the number of participants. The clock waits while the world is stopped. Damage done before the snap stays. Command /thanos start|stop|status.
codex.viltrumitecore.thanos_snap.relatio: DIO's time stop and other world pauses delay both the clock and the snap itself.
